text: dsh-pr-gate 是一款面向 DSH 的写入策略插件，通过 Cordis 工具执行钩子检查文件写入。它在写入前依据允许和拒绝路径规则判断目标，并可从 agent-pr-gate.yaml 读取策略；写入完成后会扫描文本标记，并将决策和内容哈希追加到 JSONL 记录。用户可以配置受检查的文件工具、工作区根目录和扫描命中后的处理方式，适合希望在 DSH 会话中统一应用路径规则并保留写入记录的开发者。插件使用 Node.js 20 或更新版本。

dsh-pr-gate applies allow and deny path rules before DSH file writes. It can load an agent-pr-gate.yaml policy, scan written text, and record decisions with content hashes in a JSONL ledger. Configure gated tools, workspace root, and scan handling. Requires Node.js 20+.
我想让 DSH 写文件前先按允许和拒绝路径规则检查目标。
能不能把现有的 agent-pr-gate.yaml 写入策略用于 DSH 会话？
我希望 DSH 在指定文件工具写入后扫描文本标记。
让 DSH 记录每次文件写入的路径和内容哈希，方便后续查看。
I want DSH to check file paths against allow and deny rules before writing.
Can I keep a JSONL record of file writes made during a DSH session?
dsh-pr-gate 的功能「路径策略检查」：在指定文件工具执行前提取目标路径，并按 deny 优先、非空 allow 限定范围的规则作出允许或拒绝决定；可将策略文件中的规则与内联规则合并。
dsh-pr-gate 的功能「写入文本扫描」：工具完成写入后，将写入文本交给 residue 扫描器；命中时可记录警告，或配置为返回阻止结果。
dsh-pr-gate 的功能「会话写入记录」：插件把通过或拒绝的写入决策追加到 JSONL 文件，记录工具名、路径和动作，并在成功写入时保存文本的 SHA-256 哈希。
dsh-pr-gate 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 11；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-pr-gate README · dsh-pr-gate：> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Deterministic write gate for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) —
**the CI gate moved to the moment of the write.**

dsh-pr-gate README · dsh-pr-gate：Every file the agent writes (`write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor`) passes
the same scope policy and residue rules that
[agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate) applies to PRs
in CI — deny-before-write in `tools/pre-execute`, residue scan of the written
text in `tools/post-execute`, and a durable content-hashed JSONL ledger of
every decision. Zero LLM calls in the trust path: the parts of the gate that
must NOT be an LLM live here.

dsh-pr-gate README · Why now (checked 2026-10-12)：The review/guard lane in the dsh ecosystem is entirely LLM-shaped:
answer-reviewer plugins re-read turns with a second model, `dsh-gungnir`
verifies goal completion from exit codes, and the closest action-guard
(`cc-safety-net`, 1.6k★ in the Claude ecosystem) blocks destructive commands.
**Nobody gates what the agent writes deterministically** — scope policy,
residue markers, or a durable record the CI can consume. That slot is empty,
and this plugin is the [agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate)
engine living inside the runtime instead of waiting for the PR.

dsh-pr-gate README · What it does：| Stage | Hook | Deterministic action |
|---|---|---|
| Before the write | `tools/pre-execute` | Scope policy: deny globs always win; a non-empty allow list means "only these". Denied writes never touch the disk |
| After the write | `tools/post-execute` | Residue scan of the written text: injection text aimed at reviewers, skipped tests, debug markers. `warn` (default) logs + ledgers; `block` also fails the write with corrective feedback |
| Always | JSONL ledger | One line per decision — tool, path, action, `sha256` of content, matched pattern, residue kinds. `agent-pr-gate` CI can consume it as the session-side record |

dsh-pr-gate README · One policy, two enforcement points：Point `policyFile` at your repo's `agent-pr-gate.yaml` and the live session
enforces the same allow/deny the CI gate enforces on PRs — all policy entries
are unioned. Inline `allow`/`deny` config works without a file.

dsh-pr-gate README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-pr-gate
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).

dsh-pr-gate README · Configure：```yaml
- id: dsh-pr-gate
  name: dsh-pr-gate
  config:
    tools: [write, edit, str_replace_editor]

dsh-pr-gate README · Compatibility：- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-pr-gate] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-pr-gate` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

dsh-pr-gate README · Develop：```sh
npm install
npm test   # syncs the vendored agent-pr-gate core, builds, runs unit tests
```

The scope glob semantics and residue rules are vendored from the sibling
`agent-pr-gate` checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`).

dsh-pr-gate README · Roadmap：- `bash` command write-heuristics (redirect/shell-write detection, warn-only)
- Ledger → GitHub check-run bridge (session attestations surfaced in CI)
- Per-policy selection by agent preset, matching the CI gate's policy classes
- Claims-vs-diff at turn end (the agent's final summary vs. the session ledger)

dsh-pr-gate README · Kill criteria：If dsh ships first-party deterministic write gating, or reviewer plugins
converge on deterministic enforcement (they are all LLM-based today), this
freezes at its last working version with a postmortem here. The engine stays
owned by agent-pr-gate either way.

dsh-pr-gate README · Known limitations：- **Paths are judged by their resolved target** relative to the workspace root — traversal like `src/../.github/workflows/x.yml` is normalized before matching (fixed in this release). Symlinks are NOT followed by the pure matcher (documented limitation), and there is an inherent TOCTOU window between check and write; the host's own permissions remain the hard boundary.
- **Named file tools only.** `shell` writes, custom tools, and unknown argument shapes are not gated.
- **Residue scan is post-write.** `residueMode: block` fails the tool result but does not roll back a file already on disk; default is `warn`.
- **Empty policy = open.** With no allow/deny entries, every write passes (ledger still records `written`).
